title: FATHER GOD, ALIGN ME WITH YOUR PLANS FOR THE FUTURE
text: Beloved, I want you to do me a favor right now. Wherever you are reading this, I want you to share this prayer [music] with somebody. Send it to your family members. Send it to your friends. Send it to that brother, that sister who is at a crossroads. There are people in your contact list who are confused about the future, who are standing at the junction of destiny wondering which way [music] to go. This word is not just for you, it's for them. The Holy Spirit has orchestrated this moment. And I want you to become a vessel of distribution. Share it now before you continue reading because there is an anointing on this word that will bring divine alignment. Glory to God. You know, one of the most dangerous positions a believer can find himself in is to be out of sync with the eternal agenda of heaven. You can be busy. You can be active. You can even be anointed. But if you are not aligned with the father's plans for your future, you will labor in futility. The Bible says in Jeremiah 29:11, "For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, sayeth the Lord, thoughts of peace and not of evil to give you an expected end." Expected end that is a future that is a hope. But how many of us are walking in synchronization with those divine thoughts? How many of us have taken the time to inquire of the Lord? Father, what are your plans for my [music] future? You see, God is not reactive. God is proactive. Before you were formed in your mother's womb, he knew you. Before you took your first breath, the blueprint of your destiny was already drawn in the courts of heaven. But here is a tragedy. Many believers are living their lives based on human calculation, based on probability, based on what their environment suggests, based on what their education permits, based on what their background allows. And they wonder why they are struggling. You cannot afford to build your future on the faulty foundation of human reasoning. Proverbs 3:5 tells us, "Trust in [music] the Lord with all thine heart and lean not onto thine own understanding." The moment you begin to lean on your own understanding, you have stepped out of alignment. The moment you begin to trust in [music] your wisdom more than you trust in his guidance, you have opened the door to error. I pray for somebody right now in the name of Jesus. Every plan, every agenda, every blueprint that you have constructed outside of divine instruction, I command it to collapse by fire. Every door you have been knocking on that God did not send you to. I [music] decree frustration upon that door in the name of Jesus. You will not waste your time. You will not waste your resources. You will not waste your anointing pursuing shadows. The Lord will arrest your attention and he will redirect you back to his original plan for your life. I see the spirit of the Lord orchestrating divine interruptions for someone reading this. That thing you have been forcing, God is about to show you it was never his plan. Receive clarity now in the name of Jesus. Now, let me show you something very powerful from the scriptures. In the book of Acts chapter 13, the Bible records that while the prophets and teachers at Antioch were ministering to the Lord and fasting, [music] the Holy Spirit said, "Separate me, Barnabas and Saul, for the work where [music] to I have called them." You see that the Holy Spirit has a specific work, a specific assignment, a specific mandate for individuals. Paul didn't just wake up one morning and decide, I think I want to be an apostle to the Gentiles. No, it was a divine orchestration. It was alignment with heaven's agenda. And because he was aligned, he had impact because he was synchronized with the father's plan. He turned the world upside down. But what happens when you are misaligned? Look at King Saul. 1st Samuel 15. God gave him explicit instructions [music] to completely destroy the Amalachites. But Saul did it his own way. He kept the best of the sheep. He spared the king. He modified the instruction to suit his own understanding. And Samuel came to him and said, "Had the Lord has great delight in burnt offerings and sacrifices, as in obeying the voice of the Lord? Behold, to obey is better than sacrifice, and to hearken than the fat of rams." Saul lost his kingdom because he was misaligned. He had an assignment, but he executed [music] it according to his own wisdom. I prophesy to someone right now, you will not lose your destiny because of disobedience. You will not forfeit your inheritance because you thought you knew better than God. The spirit of assumption, the spirit of presumption, the spirit of independence, I command it to be broken off your life right now in the name of Jesus. From today, you will walk in radical obedience. You will walk in total submission to the Holy Spirit. Every voice that is louder than God's voice in your life, I silence it by the authority in the name of Jesus Christ. Now, when we talk about alignment with God's plans for the future, we must understand that God's plans are multi-dimensional. They affect every area of your existence. There is a plan for your spiritual life. There is a plan for your career. There is a plan for your marriage. There is a plan for your finances. There is a plan for your ministry. There is a plan for your health and all these plans are interconnected woven together by divine wisdom. You cannot isolate one area and say God I will obey you here but over there I will do my own thing. No alignment must be total. Alignment must be comprehensive. Look at Abraham Genesis 12. God said to him, "Get thee out of thy country and from thy kindred and from thy father's house unto a land that I will shield thee." Abraham didn't know where he was going, but he went because he was aligned with divine instruction. And because he obeyed, God made [music] him the father of nations. His future was secure, not because he [music] had a detailed map, but because he had a divine guide. You see, many of us want God to show us the end from the beginning. We want to see the complete picture before we make a move. But faith doesn't work that way. alignment doesn't work that way. God gives you enough light for the next step. And as you take that step in obedience, he illuminates the next one. Father, I pray for every person reading this right now. I pray that you will grant them the grace to walk by faith and not by sight. I pray that you will deliver them from the paralysis of analysis. Deliver them from the need to understand everything before they obey. Give them a spirit of radical obedience. Give them a spirit of immediate response. Let them become like Isaiah who said, "Here am I. Send me." Let them become like Mary who said, "Be it unto me according to thy word." I pray for a generation of believers who will not negotiate with divine instructions, who will not dilute heavenly mandates, who will not compromise kingdom assignments. Let alignment become their testimony in the name of Jesus. You see, there is something I have learned in my walk with God. Divine alignment often requires divine disruption. God will sometimes disrupt your comfort to align you with his purpose. He will shake what can be shaken so that what cannot be shaken will remain. Hebrews 12 27 says, "And this word yet once more signified the removing of those things that are shaken as of things that are made that those things which cannot be shaken may remain." Some of you are going through a shaking right now. That job you lost, that relationship that ended, that opportunity that didn't work out, it wasn't a punishment, [music] it was a realignment. God is removing you from where you were settling so he can position you where you are supposed to be. I remember the story of Joseph Genesis 37-50. This young man had a dream, a vision of his future. But the path to that future was not what he expected. He went through betrayal. He went through slavery. He went through false accusation. He went through prison. Every step looked like a deviation. Every chapter looked like a delay. But in Genesis 50:20, after everything had unfolded, Joseph said to his [music] brothers, "But as for you, ye thought evil against me, but God meant it unto good to bring to pass as it is this day to save much people [music] alive." You see that what looked like misalignment was actually divine positioning. What looked like setback was actually set up. I prophesy to somebody. That thing that happened to you that you thought destroyed your future, God is about to show you it was part of the alignment process, that rejection you suffered, that door that closed, that person who left it was God protecting you from a future that was not yours. Receive the prophetic understanding now in the name of Jesus. You are not behind schedule. You are not late. You are not [music] forgotten. You are in divine alignment. And everything is working together for your good. Now, let me show you the power of prophetic alignment. In 2 Kings 3, we see the story of three kings, the king of Israel, the king of Judah, and the king of Edom, who went to war against Moab. They found themselves [music] in the wilderness with no water, and they were about to die. They called for Elisha the prophet. And Elisha said, "Thus sayeth the Lord, make this valley full of ditches. For thus sayeth the Lord, ye shall not see wind, neither shall ye see rain. Yet that valley shall be filled with water. They had to dig ditches in preparation for a miracle they couldn't yet see. That is alignment. You align yourself with the prophetic word even when your natural senses cannot perceive the manifestation. Father, I pray for prophetic sensitivity [music] for your people. Open their spiritual ears that they may hear what the spirit is saying. Open their spiritual eyes that they may see what heaven is revealing. Deliver them from spiritual dullness. Deliver them from prophetic deafness. Let them become like Samuel [music] who could hear your voice even as a child. Let them become like Elisha who could see into the spirit realm. I pray that every believer reading this will develop an acute sensitivity to divine leading. Let them know when you are speaking. Let them know when you are moving. Let them know when you are shifting things. Give them discernment. Give them perception. Give them spiritual intelligence in the name of Jesus Christ. You know, one of the reasons why many believers miss divine alignment is because they are too loud. They are too busy, too distracted, too occupied with activities that they cannot hear God when he's speaking. Psalm 46:10 says, "Be still and know that I am God." There is a place of stillness. There is a place of silence. There is a place of solitude where God speaks the [music] deepest revelations. Elijah discovered this in First Kings 19. After the great demonstration of power on Mount Camel, he ran into the wilderness and God said, "Go forth and stand upon the mount before the Lord." And there was a wind and there was an earthquake and there was fire but God was not in any of these. Then came a still small voice and that was where God was. How many of us have been looking for God in the spectacular while he has been speaking in the subtle? How many of us have been waiting for the thunder while he has been whispering? I want to challenge you today. Create space for silence. Turn off the noise. Turn off the distractions. turn off the entertainment and just wait in his presence. It is in that place that divine [music] strategies are downloaded. It is in that place that future blueprints are revealed. It is in that place that alignment happens. I see somebody reading this and the Lord is saying, "I have been trying to speak to you, but you are too busy listening to other voices." He says, "Come away with me. Come into the secret place. I have instructions that would change the trajectory of your future." Somebody obey that instruction right now. After you finish reading this, go into your room, [music] lock the door, turn off your phone, and just wait before the Lord. He has something to tell you. He has something to show you. This is your season of divine alignment. Now, let's talk about the power of prophetic declaration in alignment. You see, your words are not neutral. Your words are creative instruments. Proverbs 18:21 says, "Death and life are in the power of the tongue, and they that love it shall eat the fruit thereof." When you are aligned with God's plans, your declarations become enforcable in the realm of the spirit. You are no longer just wishing. You are no longer just hoping. You are decreeing what heaven has already established. Look at Ezekiel 37, the valley of dry bones. God asks Ezekiel, "Can these bones leave?" And Ezekiel said, "Oh Lord God, thou knowest." Then God said, "Prophesy upon these bones and say unto them, oh ye dry bones, hear the word of the Lord." Ezekiel had to prophesy to dead bones. He had to declare life into a situation that looked impossible. And as he prophesied, [music] there was a noise. There was a shaking. The bones came together, flesh came upon them, [music] breath came into them, and they lived. That is the power of prophetic declaration. When you are aligned with divine intention right now, I want you to open your mouth and begin to prophesy to your future. I don't care what it looks like right now. I don't care how dead it appears. You have the authority to call it back to life. Say this after me. My future, hear the word of the Lord. Every dry bone in my destiny, I command you to leave. Every dead dream, every buried vision, every aborted purpose, I call you forth by the authority in the name of Jesus. I decree alignment with divine purpose over my life. I decree synchronization with heaven's agenda. I decree that every plan of God for my life shall come to pass. I shall not miss my moment. I shall not miss my season. I shall not miss my time. I am aligned with the plans of the father and my future is secure in Jesus name. Glory to God. Do you feel that? That is the anointing for alignment resting upon you right now. The Holy Spirit is doing a recalibration in your spirit. Things are shifting. Things are changing. Things are being rearranged. What was out of order is coming into order. What was displaced is being repositioned. What was delayed is being accelerated. This is your moment. Let me take you to the book of Esther. Here was a young Jewish girl who became queen in a foreign land. She didn't plan it. She didn't strategize it. It was divine orchestration. And when the crisis came, when her man plotted to destroy all the Jews, Modi said to her in chapter 4:14, "And who knoweth whether thou had come to the kingdom for such a time as this?" You see that Esther's alignment with God's plan was not just for her benefit. [music] It was for the preservation of a nation. Your alignment is not just about you. There are people connected to your destiny. There are generations that will be affected by whether or not you walk in divine alignment. Some of you reading this right now, you are carriers of generational blessing. You are the answer to the prayers of your ancestors. You are the fulfillment of prophetic declarations that were made over your family line. But the enemy knows this and he has been fighting to keep you misaligned. He has been sending distractions. He has been sending delays. He has been sending discouragement. [music] All to keep you from stepping into the fullness of what God has ordained. But I decree today, enough is enough. Every [music] satanic conspiracy against your alignment, I command it to scatter by fire. Every demon assigned to confuse you, to mislead you, to disorient you, I bind you and cast you out in the name of Jesus. The clarity of heaven is [music] coming upon this person right now. They will know what to do. They will know where to go. They will know who to connect with. Divine alignment is their portion. Now, I want to talk about the role of divine connections in alignment. You see, God doesn't just align you with his plans. He aligns you with people who are key to those plans. In Acts 9, after Saul's conversion on the Damascus road, God sent a man named Ananas to him. Ananas was not famous. He was not a prominent apostle. But he was the right person for that moment. He laid hands on Saul and Saul received his sight and was filled with the Holy Spirit. That was a divine connection that facilitated alignment. How many of you are waiting for a divine connection? How many of you know that there is someone you need to meet? Someone who carries a key to your next level. I prophesy to you, the God who orchestrated the meeting between Ruth and Boaz, the God who orchestrated the meeting between David and Jonathan, the God who orchestrated the meeting between Elijah and Elisha, that same God is orchestrating a divine connection for you before this year runs out. You will meet the right person. You will be in the right place at the right time. You will have a conversation that will change everything. [music] Receive it in the name of Jesus. But let me warn you, not every connection is a divine connection. There are some people who will connect with you, but they are agents of misalignment. They will take you off course. They will drain your anointing. They will contaminate your vision. 2 Corinthians 6:14 says, "Be ye not unequally yolked together with unbelievers. [music] For what fellowship hath righteousness with unrighteousness, and what communion hath light with darkness?" You must have discernment. You must be sensitive to the spirit. Not everyone who is friendly is sent by God. Not everyone who is impressive is aligned with your destiny. Father, I pray for discernment for your children. Give them the ability to recognize divine connections and the wisdom to avoid demonic associations. Let them not be deceived by appearances. Let them not be swayed by eloquence. Let them not be manipulated by pressure. Give them a spirit of discernment that they may know who is from you and who is not. I pray that every wrong relationship, every toxic connection, every draining association, let it be exposed and severed in the name of Jesus. And let every divine connection, every heaven-sent relationship, every destiny helper, let them locate this person speedily [music] in the mighty name of Jesus Christ. Let me tell you something very important. Alignment with God's plans sometimes requires the courage to stand alone. There will be seasons where you will not have the support of the crowd. Where your vision will not make sense to those around you. Where your obedience will be questioned by people who claim to love you. Noah experienced this when he was building the ark. Abraham experienced this when he was living or Moses experienced this when he was leading Israel out of Egypt. Jesus experienced this throughout his ministry. But I want you to understand something. The approval of men is not a prerequisite for divine alignment. In fact, if everybody's applauding you, if everybody is comfortable with your decisions, you might want to check if you are truly walking in God's will or if you are just conforming to popular opinion. Galatians 1:10 says, "For do I now persuade men or God, or do I seek to please men? For if I yet please men, I should not be the servant of Christ. I speak to someone who has been paralyzed by the fear of what people will say. The Lord says, "Break free. Break free from the prison of public opinion. Break free from the cage of people's expectations. I did not call you to please them. [music] I call you to obey me. I decree that every fear of men, every need for validation, every craving for approval, it is broken off your life right now in the name of Jesus. You will walk in divine confidence. You will walk in holy boldness. You will walk in supernatural courage. People's opinions will no longer control you. People's criticism will no longer define [music] you. People's rejection will no longer limit you. You are aligned with the father and that is all that matters. Now let's talk about the enemy's strategy against alignment. You see, Satan knows that a believer who is aligned with God's purposes is extremely dangerous. Such a believer cannot be stopped, cannot be intimidated, cannot be derailed. So the enemy's primary strategy is to create misalignment. He does this through several means. deception, distraction, discouragement, and delay. Deception. He makes you believe that God's plan is [music] not good enough, that there is a better way, a faster route, a more comfortable option. He [music] did this to Eve in the garden. Have God said? He plants seeds of doubt about God's word, about God's goodness, about God's timing, distraction. He throws so many options at you, so many opportunities, so many voices that you become confused [music] about what God actually said. You become like the man in James chapter 1 who is double-minded, unstable in all his ways, driven by the wind and tossed. Discouragement. When you step out in obedience to God's plan, the enemy sends challenges, obstacles, resistance to make you feel like you made the wrong decision. He wants you to turn back, to give up, to abort the mission delay. He makes things take longer than you expected, longer than you can endure, so that you become weary and settle for less [music] than God's best. But I have good news for you today. Greater is he that is in you than he that is in the world. The enemy's strategies will not work against you. I decree that every deception, the Lord will expose it. Every distraction, the Lord will remove it. Every discouragement, the Lord [music] will turn it to encouragement. Every delay, the Lord will break it and release acceleration. You are a candidate for divine alignment and nothing shall stop you. Let me pray for you now. [music] Father, in the name of Jesus, I come before your throne of grace. on behalf of every person reading this. Lord, I thank you because you are a God of order, a God of purpose, a God of precision. You are not a God of confusion and your plans for your children are plans of good and not of evil. Right now, I pray for alignment. I pray that every life that is out of sync with your divine agenda, let there be a recalibration by the power of the Holy [music] Spirit. Every person who has been walking in the wrong direction, I pray for a divine cause correction. Turn them around. Redirect their steps. Realign their focus. Father, where there has been confusion, release clarity. Where there has been doubt, release faith. Where there has been fear, release courage. I pray that you will speak to them in ways they cannot miss. [music] In ways they cannot ignore, in ways they cannot misinterpret. Let your voice become the loudest voice [music] in their lives. Let your wisdom override their human reasoning. Let your plan supersede their personal ambitions. I pray for the destruction of every satanic agenda against their destiny. Every plot, [music] every scheme, every device of the enemy, let it backfire in Jesus name. Every trap set for them, let the enemy fall into it himself. Every weapon fashioned against them, I declare [music] it shall not prosper. Every tongue that rises against them in judgment, I condemn it according to Isaiah 54:17. I speak to their future right now. Future. Align yourself with the plans of the father. Every door that God has ordained to open, I command you to open now. Every opportunity that heaven has prepared, I command you to present yourself. Every divine connection, every destiny helper, every favor career, I command you to locate this person speedily, every blessing that has been delayed, I decree release. Every promise that has been held back, I decree manifestation. Every good thing that God has spoken over this life, I decree that it shall come to pass. I pray that their spiritual eyes will be open to see what heaven is revealing. I pray that their spiritual ears will be open to hear what the spirit is saying. I pray that their spiritual senses will be sharpened to discern the times and seasons. Let them know when to move and when to wait, when to speak and when to be silent, when to act and when to [music] rest. Father, I pray against every spirit of presumption. Let them not assume. Let them inquire of you. Let them not lean on their understanding. Let them trust in you with all their heart. Give them a heart of humility, a spirit of submission, a posture of obedience. Let them become like clay in the potter's hand, moldable, shapable, willing to be fashioned according to your design. I decree that they shall fulfill destiny. They shall accomplish purpose. They shall complete assignment. They shall not die prematurely. They shall not fall short. They shall not settle for less. They are aligned with the plans [music] of the father and their future is glorious. In the mighty name of Jesus Christ, I have prayed. Amen. Glory to God. Somebody shout hallelujah. You see, when you are aligned with God's plans, you don't just survive, [music] you thrive. You don't just exist, you flourish. You don't just get by, you overflow. Psalm 1 says that the man who delights in the law of the Lord is like [music] a tree planted by the rivers of water that brings forth his fruit in his season. His leaf also shall not wither and whatsoever he doeth shall prosper. That is the promise for alignment. Before I close, I want to give you some practical steps for maintaining alignment with God's plans. Number one, develop a consistent devotional life. You cannot stay aligned with someone you are not talking to. Prayer is not optional. It is essential. Bible study is not a luxury. It is a necessity. Spend time in God's presence daily, not as a religious routine, but as a vital relationship. Number two, be sensitive to the leading of the Holy Spirit. Romans 8:14 says, "For as many as are led by the spirit of God, they are the sons of God." The Holy Spirit is your guide, your teacher, your counselor. Learn to recognize his voice. Learn to follow his prompings. Learn to obey his instructions even when they don't make natural sense. Number three, surround yourself with prophetic voices. You need people in your life who can speak into your destiny, who can see what you cannot see, who can call forth what is not yet manifest. But be careful. Don't just follow any voice. Test the spirits. Confirm everything with the word of God. Number four, be willing to make adjustments. Alignment is not a one-time event. It is a continuous process. As God reveals more, you must be willing to change course, to let go of old plans, to embrace new directions. Flexibility is a sign of wisdom. Number five, trust God's timing. Just because you know God's plan doesn't mean it will happen immediately. There is a set time for every purpose under heaven. Don't get ahead of God and don't lag behind. Stay in sync with his timing. I declare over you today, you are aligned with the plans of the father. Your future [music] is not determined by your past. Your destiny is not limited by your present. You are a child of the most high God and his plans for you are exceedingly abundantly above all you [music] can ask or think. This is your season of alignment, your season of clarity, [music] your season of acceleration. Walk in it. Walk boldly. Walk confidently. The Lord is with you and you shall not fail in Jesus's mighty name. Amen and amen.
